name: benchgen_lerobot_dataset_filtered
description: A filtered dataset of robot-related instruction–response examples intended to evaluate LLMs on instruction following and generation of robot action sequences. It focuses on realistic, high-quality examples suitable for testing correctness and robustness of generated commands or plans. Common uses include measuring instruction adherence and downstream task success.
reputation: Relatively new / limited adoption; used by researchers working on instruction-following and robot command generation.
